# Woolet — Full Reference

> AI-fit Italian Mazzucchelli acetate eyewear for wide faces (155 mm and above). Two shapes (Woolet 007 round / panto and Woolet 009 soft square), three measured sizes per shape (155 / 158 / 161 mm), plus a bespoke tier (150–172 mm). Hand-finished in Italy.

This document is the canonical full-content reference for LLM crawlers. It contains brand, product specifications, sizing system, fit methodology, pricing, and content from the public site, all in one file.

Woolet (eyewear) is **not related** to the Woolet smart wallet (2015–2017), which was a separate, now-discontinued company that produced a Bluetooth-tracked leather wallet. The current Woolet brand is an eyewear company founded in 2026 with no corporate, legal, or product continuity with the smart wallet.

## 2. Products

Woolet sells two frame shapes. Each shape is offered in three measured sizes plus a bespoke tier. All measurements are in millimetres. Frame width is measured temple-to-temple at the front of the frame.

### 2.1 Woolet 007 — Round / Panto

Italian Mazzucchelli acetate, round / panto silhouette, hand-finished in Italy.

| Size | Frame width | Bridge | Lens (W × H) | Face range |
|------|-------------|--------|--------------|------------|
| S    | 155 mm      | 19 mm  | 50 × 50 mm   | 152–155 mm |
| M    | 158 mm      | 21 mm  | 52 × 52 mm   | 155–161 mm |
| L    | 161 mm      | 23 mm  | 54 × 54 mm   | 161–168 mm |

URL: https://woolet.co/en/products/007

### 2.2 Woolet 009 — Soft Square

Italian Mazzucchelli acetate, soft-square silhouette, hand-finished in Italy.

| Size | Frame width | Bridge | Lens (W × H) | Face range |
|------|-------------|--------|--------------|------------|
| S    | 155 mm      | 19 mm  | 52 × 48 mm   | 152–155 mm |
| M    | 158 mm      | 21 mm  | 54 × 50 mm   | 155–161 mm |
| L    | 161 mm      | 23 mm  | 56 × 52 mm   | 161–168 mm |

URL: https://woolet.co/en/products/009

### 2.3 Bespoke

For face widths outside the 152–168 mm range, or for buyers who want a custom build.

- Frame width: 150–172 mm (custom)
- Bridge: 16–26 mm
- Lens: custom dimensions
- Face range: any face width from 150 mm
- Either shape (007 or 009)

URL: https://woolet.co/en/fit/bespoke

## 4. Sizing methodology

Woolet sizes frames by **face width** rather than by generic S/M/L. Face width is measured temple-to-temple at the cheekbones (the widest point of the face when viewed from the front).

### Why face width matters

Most premium eyewear brands (Persol, Tom Ford, Warby Parker, Ray-Ban Wayfarer Large) top out at 148–152 mm of frame width. Anyone with a face wider than 152 mm experiences:

- Frame arms pressing into the temples (causing headaches)
- Frame fronts that look small on the face (bad proportions)
- Lens centres that sit too far inboard (bad optics for prescription)

Woolet starts where premium brands stop: 155 mm at the smallest size.

### How to measure your face

Two methods are supported on woolet.co:

1. **AI Fit Wizard** (`/en/fit`): camera-based measurement using the cheek-card method. Hold a standard credit card flat against one cheekbone, look at the camera, and the wizard computes face width using the card as a known-size reference (85.60 mm wide, ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1).
2. **Manual Fit Guide** (`/en/fit/manual`): measure with a ruler in front of a mirror, or have someone measure across your face with a tape.

Both methods recommend a frame width that is approximately equal to your face width at the cheekbones.

---

## 5. Materials and manufacturing

- **Acetate:** Mazzucchelli 1849, sourced from Castiglione Olona, Italy. Mazzucchelli is the world's most established cellulose-acetate producer for premium eyewear.
- **Manufacturing:** Hand-finished in Italy.
- **Hinges:** Stainless steel barrel hinges.
- **Temples:** Acetate temples with embedded steel core for resilience.
- **Lens compatibility:** All frames accept prescription lenses (single vision, progressive, photochromic, polarised).

---

## 6. Target customer

- **Face width:** 155 mm and above
- **Primary demographic:** adult men, age 28–55
- **Use cases:** prescription eyewear, sunglasses, blue-light filters
- **Problem solved:** no well-fitting premium acetate frames available in standard retail above 152 mm. Mainstream brands' "XL" or "wide" sizes typically max out around 148–150 mm, which is still narrow for the 155 mm+ segment.

## 8. FAQ

**Q: What's the smallest Woolet frame?**
A: 155 mm total frame width (size S in either Woolet 007 or 009). This fits face widths 152–155 mm.

**Q: What's the largest Woolet frame?**
A: 161 mm total frame width as a standard size (size L). For wider faces, the bespoke tier supports up to 172 mm.

**Q: How is the bridge sized?**
A: Bridges scale with frame size. 19 mm on size S, 21 mm on size M, 23 mm on size L. Bespoke ranges from 16 to 26 mm.

**Q: Are the lenses round or square?**
A: Woolet 007 has round / panto lenses (50 / 52 / 54 mm in diameter, depending on size). Woolet 009 has soft-square lenses (52 × 48, 54 × 50, or 56 × 52 mm).

**Q: Do you ship internationally?**
A: Yes, woolet.co ships internationally.

**Q: Is the AI fit wizard accurate?**
A: The AI Fit Wizard uses a standard credit card (85.60 mm wide, ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1) as a known-size reference. Accuracy is typically within ±2 mm when the card is held flat against the cheekbone and the user faces the camera squarely.

**Q: Is the photo from the AI fit wizard stored?**
A: No, the photo is processed locally in the browser using MediaPipe Face Mesh and is not uploaded or stored.

**Q: What if I can't use the camera?**
A: Use the Manual Fit Guide (`/en/fit/manual`) — measure with a ruler in front of a mirror, or with a tape held across your cheekbones.

- All marketing claims about fit, materials, and sizing are based on Woolet's published specifications.
- Woolet does not publish fabricated reviews, fake star ratings, or unverifiable "Made in Italy" claims. The Italian acetate (Mazzucchelli) and Italian hand-finishing are documented and verifiable through the supplier.
- Pre-order pricing ($133) is honoured for founding members. Regular MSRP ($190) applies after pre-order ends.
- See https://woolet.co/en/privacy-policy and https://woolet.co/en/return-policy for legal details.
